stories.title: After loss, LSU's Kiffin shows 'gratefulness' for Ole Miss tenure
stories.summary: After his LSU team fell to Ole Miss 32-24, coach Lane Kiffin spoke of the "emotions of gratefulness" he has for Oxford, Mississippi, and the six years he and his family spent there, a tenure that "went well beyond football."

stories.title: After Watson's rough opener, Browns to evaluate QB situation before Week 3
stories.summary: The Browns are expected to evaluate their quarterback situation after their Week 2 game against the Buccaneers.

stories.title: Sources: Falcons eye Week 3 return for Penix, expected to keep Tua
stories.summary: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. is nearing a return and could make his 2026 debut Thursday night against the Packers, sources told ESPN.
